hooks.label: v3 · hook H2
hooks.vo: Buying a laptop soon? AI's making it pricier.
hooks.tts: Buying a laptop soon? ... AI's making it pricier.
hooks.frame0: AI IS MAKING YOUR NEXT LAPTOP PRICIER
hooks.image: FRAME 0, cozy desk nook at night: the thumb taps Add to cart under a new laptop on the phone and its price tag ticks up; the old laptop on the desk; an AI DATA CENTER tower pressed against the frosty window, scooping memory chips

body.vo: AI data centers get first dibs on the memory chips your laptop needs.
body.tts: AI data centers get first dibs ... on the memory chips your laptop needs.
body.image: conveyor outside, close and low: the viewer's hand and the data center's giant scoop reach for one glowing chip; the scoop is served first, the hand still gets its chip, but the chip's tag ticks up

body.vo: In the US, computers are up almost 10% in a year, after 20 years of getting cheaper, give or take a pandemic.
body.tts: In the US, computers are up almost ten percent in a year, after twenty years of getting cheaper ... give or take a pandemic.
body.image: price line drawn on the fogged window hooks up, brass tag +9.7% (US, BLS); pull back along the long slide from 2005 to 2025, one small 2021 bump wearing a face mask

body.vo: Mostly because memory chips cost about 5x last year's price.
body.tts: Mostly because memory chips cost about five times last year's price.
body.image: inside the new laptop: the memory + storage pie slice swells from ~15% to almost 40%; one memory chip lifts out alone and its tag flips x2, x3, x4, about 5x

body.vo: AI data centers need mountains of them, and they pay more.
body.tts: AI data centers need mountains of them ... and they pay more.
body.image: SCALE MOMENT: pull back over the snowy town to the AI data center rising into haze; a mountain of chips slides into its loading door; one rack beside ~1,300 tiny laptops

body.vo: It's less of a shortage, more of an auction, and you're bidding against a building.
body.tts: It's less of a shortage, more of an auction ... and you're bidding against a building.
body.image: a SHORTAGE shelf swings open onto a warm auction hall, LOT 1: MEMORY CHIPS; the polite giant data center raises a billboard paddle, the tiny viewer holds up their phone

body.vo: The bids are still climbing, so the cheap laptops drop out first.
body.tts: The bids are still climbing, so the cheap laptops drop out first.
body.image: COZY ENCLOSURE, back in the nook: a price updated card pops on the phone; the cheapest laptop listings grey out one by one, no longer available

body.vo: Experts give it a year or two.
body.tts: Experts give it a year or two.
body.image: a paper wall calendar flips 2026, 2027, 2028 by the frosty window; the data center glows outside

body.vo: That's how a data center ends up on your next laptop's price tag.
body.tts: That's how a data center ends up on your next laptop's price tag.
body.image: close on the phone: the price tag turns over and shows a tiny ink data center on its back; the thumb drifts back over Add to cart, hard cut to frame 0
